title: goniolimon tataricum
intro: Goniolimon tataricum, commonly known as Tatarian goniolimon or Tatarian cotton grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Plumbaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Goniolimon tataricum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its healing effects on the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
